searchText: Cell Level Deltas now in Lighthouses `unstable` 🚀 <@412614104222531604> I suggest you keep the devnet pointed at my branch though, so I can use it to push any fixes/improvements before they hit `unstable` <@106441459183423488> merged your PR 🙂 Thank you! <@1000001410538151996> is fix for the full data column traffic running on blob-devnet-0? yeah, but the effect is not as I expected, so I am investigating further Ok, the remaining traffic seems to only related to the non-partial-messages nodes running outside of the network. I do not have an explanation why LH seems have more traffic to those nodes than prysm. Maybe one of the things to investigate next week. On the bright side - LH seems to have these nodes in its mesh still after days of almost only partial message activity, so non-partial messages nodes seem to survive in an otherwise partial message only network. Good to know. Seeing that most of the times, cells "win the race" as per marcos dashboard, we also do not survive only because of those nodes I fear that for pure partial messages networks we have to stick to local devnets and simulations
